_metadata.description: Curated denylist of word pairs that look decomposable but are NOT productive compounds. Used by nb-sarskriving-tentative to suppress tentative findings on known false-positive classes (sourced from Phase 17-06 removal post-mortem + ongoing curator additions).
_metadata.schema: pairs[<left>|<right>] = { reason: string, addedBy: string, votes: { yes: number, no: number } }

far|dag.reason: Sentence-internal subject+object collision; the real compound 'farsdag' uses fuge-s, not zero-linker.

mor|dag.reason: Same pattern as far|dag; 'morsdag' uses fuge-s.

han|tek.reason: Subject pronoun + finite verb; never a compound.

stor|by.reason: Adjective + noun; 'storby' is a real compound but the adjective-pre-noun phrase is far more common — gate the tentative tier to article-like left context only.

fin|dag.reason: Adjective + noun pair, common idiomatic phrase 'ein fin dag'; no compound.

lang|dag.reason: Adjective + noun pair, idiomatic 'ein lang dag'; no compound.

ny|dag.reason: Adjective + noun pair, idiomatic 'ein ny dag'; no compound.

videregående|skole.reason: fast frase — videregående skole er aldri samansett (Wikipedia-presisjonskorpus 2026-06-12)

rett|tid.reason: adj+substantiv-frase («i rett tid»); retttid er ikkje eit ord (Wikipedia-presisjonskorpus 2026-06-12)

død|våren.reason: frase («fraus i hel død våren …») — adj + bestemt substantiv (Wikipedia-presisjonskorpus 2026-06-12)
